The KIOTI CK3520SE Series: Powerful, Practical, and Built to Work.

The KIOTI CK3520SE Manual ROPS model is a versatile compact tractor designed for hardworking landowners, farmers, and property professionals. Powered by a reliable 35-horsepower 3-cylinder Daedong diesel engine, this 4WD tractor features an 8-forward and 8-reverse mechanical shuttle transmission for precise control and ease of operation. The manual ROPS (rollover protective structure) provides essential safety while maintaining an open operator station ideal for those who prefer unobstructed visibility and accessibility. Perfect for loader work, mowing, tillage, and a wide variety of outdoor tasks.

Features May Include:

  • Engine: 35 hp, 3-cylinder Daedong diesel, Tier 4 compliant

  • Transmission: 8F / 8R Mechanical Shuttle for smooth directional changes

  • Drive: Mechanically engaged 4WD for enhanced traction

  • Power Steering: Hydraulic power steering for responsive, easy control

  • PTO: Independent rear PTO with approx. 28 hp for implements

  • Hydraulics: 11.3 GPM total flow with Category I 3-point hitch, lifting approx. 1,631 lbs

  • Brakes: Durable wet disc brakes for reliable stopping power

  • ROPS: Foldable manual rollover protective structure for operator safety

  • Ground Clearance: Approximately 13.4 in.

  • Wheelbase: 65.7 in. (1,670 mm)

  • Turning Radius: 8.3 ft. (2.5 m) with brakes

  • Operating Weight: Approx. 2,780 lbs (without loader)
